title: eremopyrum orientale var. lanuginosum
intro: Eremopyrum orientale var. lanuginosum, commonly known as woolly wheat grass or woolly wheat grass plant, is a type of perennial grass. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Eremopyrum orientale var. lanuginosum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
